deha-p01-v01.speaker: Poet (maṅgala)
deha-p01-v01.question: What is declared?
premises: Body declared god-temple; own self the eternal god.
Cast off ignorance-sweepings; worship with I-am-He feeling.
deha-p01-v01.inference: The frame vow: body as temple, self as god, worship as so'ham-feeling after casting ignorance.

deha-p01-v02.speaker: Poet (gatekeeper Gaṇapati)
deha-p01-v02.question: Who stands at the gate?
premises: Saluted by demon-and-god hosts in bestowing wished boons; engaged.
Foremost in a hundred rites; breath-bodied Gaṇapati.
deha-p01-v02.inference: Gaṇapati as prāṇa-gatekeeper: worshipped first, breath-bodied, boon-bestowing (Dyczkowski: master of the body's pīṭhas).

deha-p01-v03.speaker: Poet (gatekeeper Vaṭuka)
deha-p01-v03.question: Who guards with him?
premises: Foot-pair worshipped by heroes, yoginīs, siddhas.
Remover of humble folks' pain; Vaṭuka apāna-named.
deha-p01-v03.inference: Vaṭuka as apāna-gatekeeper: worshipped by adepts, remover of disciples' knots and doubts (Dyczkowski).

deha-p01-v04.speaker: Poet (guru)
deha-p01-v04.question: Who gives understanding?
premises: By-whose-mind-strength the universe shines Śiva-pathed for devotees.
Him-I-attention-formed; spotless true guru always.
deha-p01-v04.inference: The Sadguru gives intellectual strength (avadhāna) by which the world shines as Śiva-path — Dyczkowski's śuddha-vidyā after long loving approach.

deha-p01-v05.speaker: Poet (presiding Bhairava)
deha-p01-v05.question: Who dwells in the heart?
premises: By own sense-feasts the sense-goddesses always in the heart-lotus fully honor.
Whom-him: consciousness-made bliss-Bhairava.
deha-p01-v05.inference: Ānanda-Bhairava, ever-blissful core (cinmaya, Cakreśvara seat), fed by sense-goddesses; pleasure, pain, sorrow all rendered as offerings.

deha-p01-v06.speaker: Poet (consort Bhairavī)
deha-p01-v06.question: Who is beside him?
premises: Dawn-shining-chewing-play of the universe she makes ceaselessly.
Bliss-Bhairavī; her deliberation-formed.
deha-p01-v06.inference: Ānanda-Bhairavī as vimarśa (awareness-energy, svātantrya-śakti), non-different from Śiva as heat from fire; aggregate of awareness.

deha-p01-v07.speaker: Poet (eastern petal)
deha-p01-v07.question: Who offers resolve?
premises: Who worships Bhairava with resolve-flowers, standing in the lord's petal.
I bow to intellect-formed Brāhmaṇī, her-I, ever.
deha-p01-v07.inference: Brāhmī (buddhi, east petal) confirms outside perceptions and offers them as niścaya-flowers to the heart-lotus.

deha-p01-v08.speaker: Poet (Agni petal)
deha-p01-v08.question: Who offers I-ness?
premises: She performs Bhairava-worship, fire-petal-standing, with I-flowers.
Ever-I-making-formed; I praise her, the Śāmbhavī mother.
deha-p01-v08.inference: Śāmbhavī (ahaṅkāra, Agni petal) worships with I-flowers; ego itself becomes the offering, not the obstacle.

deha-p02-v09.speaker: Poet (southern petal)
deha-p02-v09.question: Who offers thoughts?
premises: She lays out Bhairava-honor, south-petal-seated, with distinction-flowers.
Ever mind-formed Kaumārī, her-I.
deha-p02-v09.inference: Kaumārī (manas, south/Yama petal) offers thoughts; edition viśeṣa adopted (flower-pattern fit), variant vikalpa recorded (fits mind-goddess).

option_choices.reason: Edition viśeṣa (distinction) fits the flower-offering pattern (niścaya/śabda/sparśa-flowers); variant vikalpa recorded — apt for mind-goddess but not the edition text.

deha-p02-v10.speaker: Poet (southwest petal)
deha-p02-v10.question: Who offers sounds?
premises: Southwest-petal-seated worships Bhairava with sound-flowers.
I bow to hearing-formed, ever her, the Vaiṣṇavī power.
deha-p02-v10.inference: Vaiṣṇavī (śruti/ear, Nirṛti petal) garlands sounds; edition śabda-flowers adopted (flower-pattern), variant śabdarūpā recorded.

option_choices.reason: Edition śabdakusumairyā keeps the flower-offering grammar shared with vv7-9; variant śabdarūpām recorded — lexical but restructures the line.

deha-p02-v11.speaker: Poet (western petal)
deha-p02-v11.question: Who offers touch?
premises: West-quarter-petal-placed, with heart-pleasing touch-flowers, delights Bhairava.
Her skin-form-wearing I honor: Vārāhī.
deha-p02-v11.inference: Vārāhī (tvac/touch, west petal) pleases Bhairava with tactile offerings.

deha-p02-v12.speaker: Poet (northwest petal)
deha-p02-v12.question: Who offers sight?
premises: With choicer form-details, wind-quarter-petal-seated-bodied, who honors Bhairava.
Her-Indrāṇī, sight-bodied.
deha-p02-v12.inference: Indrāṇī (dṛk/sight, Vāyu petal) offers forms; choicer details are her flowers.

deha-p02-v13.speaker: Poet (northern petal)
deha-p02-v13.question: Who offers taste?
premises: Wealth-lord-sprout-abiding, who ever with varied six-taste foods honors Bhairava.
Her tongue-called I honor: Cāmuṇḍā.
deha-p02-v13.inference: Cāmuṇḍā (jihvā/tongue, Kubera/north petal) offers the six tastes.

deha-p02-v14.speaker: Poet (northeast petal)
deha-p02-v14.question: Who offers smell?
premises: Northeast-petal-seated worships Bhairava with varying perfumes.
I bow always to her, nose-called Mahālakṣmī.
deha-p02-v14.inference: Mahālakṣmī (ghrāṇa/smell, Īśāna petal) offers perfumes; the eight-petalled circle stands complete.

deha-p02-v15.speaker: Poet (field-lord)
deha-p02-v15.question: Who guards the field?
premises: In six views worshipable, thirty-six-reality-infused, self-named ever.
Field-lord, siddhi-giving.
deha-p02-v15.inference: Kṣetrapati as first-person-experiencer (ātman), 36-tattva-bodied, worshipped in all six systems, protector on all sides.

deha-p02-v16.speaker: Poet (seal)
deha-p02-v16.question: How does it close?
premises: Quivering-experience-essential, all-within, ever-near-placed.
I hymn ever-risen-thus my-body-dwelling-god-circle.
deha-p02-v16.inference: Collective bow to the ever-present vibrating circle as first-person experience-essence; the stotra's seal.
uncertainties: sarvāntaḥ case (all-ended vs in-all-ends) left open at L0 AMBIGUOUS; sense unaffected.

deha-p01-v01.plain_english: The body is proclaimed a temple of God, the own self the eternal God; casting off the sweepings of ignorance, let him worship with the feeling I-am-He.
deha-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: deho devālayaḥ proktaḥ svātmā devaḥ sanātanaḥ | tyajedajñānanirmālyaṃ so'haṃ bhāvena pūjayet

deha-p01-v02.plain_english: Him who is saluted by the hosts of demons and gods, engaged in bestowing wished-for boons, worshipable as foremost in a hundred rites, breath-bodied — Gaṇapati I praise.

deha-p01-v03.plain_english: Whose foot-pair is worshipped by choice heroes, troops of yoginīs, rows of perfected ones; who removes the pain of humble folk — Vaṭuka, named apāna, I praise.

deha-p01-v04.plain_english: By whose mind-strength the universe shines as Śiva's path for devotees — him, intent in attention, the stainless true guru, always I praise.
deha-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: yaddhībalena viśvaṃ bhaktānāṃ śivapathaṃ bhāti | tamahamavadhānarūpaṃ sadgurumamalaṃ sadā vande

deha-p01-v05.plain_english: With feasts of their own sense-objects the sense-goddesses ever fully honor in the heart-lotus — whom, him, made of consciousness, bliss-Bhairava, I praise.
deha-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: ātmīyaviṣayabhogairindriyadevyaḥ sadā hṛdambhoje | abhipūjayanti yaṃ taṃ cinmayamānandabhairavaṃ vande

deha-p01-v06.plain_english: The play of the dawning, shining forth, and chewing over of the universe, which she performs unceasingly — bliss-Bhairavī, her, whose form is reflection, I praise.
deha-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: udayāvabhāsacarvaṇalīlāṃ viśvasya yā karotyaniśam | ānandabhairavīṃ tāṃ vimarśarūpāmahaṃ vande

deha-p01-v07.plain_english: Who worships Bhairava with flowers of resolve, standing in the petal of the lord — to intellect-formed Brāhmaṇī, to her, I ever bow.
deha-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: arcayati bhairavaṃ yā niścayakusumaiḥ sureśapatrasthā | praṇamāmi buddhirūpāṃ brahmāṇīṃ tāmahaṃ satatam

deha-p01-v08.plain_english: She performs Bhairava's worship, standing in fire's petal, with flowers of I-making — ever of I-making form, I praise her, Śāmbhavī the mother.

deha-p02-v09.plain_english: She spreads Bhairava's worship, seated in the southern petal, with flowers of distinction — ever mind-formed Kaumārī, her, I praise.
deha-p02-v09.sanskrit_cite: vidadhāti bhairavārcāṃ dakṣiṇadalagā viṣeśakusumairyā | nityaṃ manaḥsvarūpāṃ kaumārīṃ tāmahaṃ vande

deha-p02-v10.plain_english: Seated in the southwest petal she worships Bhairava with flowers of sound — to hearing-formed her, ever, I bow, the Vaiṣṇavī power.
deha-p02-v10.sanskrit_cite: nairṛtadalagā bhairavamarcayate śabdakusumairyā | praṇamāmi śrutirūpāṃ nityaṃ tāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktim

deha-p02-v11.plain_english: Standing firm in the western quarter's petal, with heart-delighting flowers of touch she delights Bhairava — her who wears the form of skin I honor: Vārāhī.
deha-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: paścimadigdalasaṃsthā hṛdayaharaiḥ sparśakusumairyā | toṣayati bhairavaṃ tāṃ tvagrūpadharāṃ namāmi vārāhīm

deha-p02-v12.plain_english: With choicer details of form, her body seated in the wind-quarter's petal — she who honors Bhairava, her Indrāṇī, sight-bodied, I praise.
deha-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: varatararūpaviśeṣairmārutadigdalaniṣaṇṇadehā yā | pūjayati bhairavaṃ tāmindrāṇīṃ dṛktanuṃ vande

deha-p02-v13.plain_english: Dwelling in the sprout of the wealth-lord, she who ever with foods of varied six tastes honors Bhairava — her called tongue I honor: Cāmuṇḍā.
deha-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: dhanapatikisalayanilayā yā nityaṃ vividhaṣaḍrasāhāraiḥ | pūjayati bhairavaṃ tāṃ jihvābhikhyāṃ namāmi cāmuṇḍām

deha-p02-v14.plain_english: Seated in Īśa's petal she worships Bhairava with manifold perfumes — to her called nose, Mahālakṣmī, I ever bow.
deha-p02-v14.sanskrit_cite: īśadalasthā bhairavamarcayate parimalairvicitrairyā | praṇamāmi sarvadā tāṃ ghrāṇābhikhyāṃ mahālakṣmīm

deha-p02-v15.plain_english: Worshipable in the six views, infused with the thirty-six realities, ever self-named — the field-lord, giver of siddhis, I praise.
deha-p02-v15.sanskrit_cite: ṣaḍdarśaneṣu pūjyaṃ ṣaḍtriṃśattattvasaṃvalitam | ātmābhikhyaṃ satataṃ kṣetrapatiṃ siddhidaṃ vande

deha-p02-v16.plain_english: The quivering pith of experience, within all, ever close at hand — thus ever arisen I hymn my own body's circle of gods.
deha-p02-v16.sanskrit_cite: saṃsphuradanubhavasāraṃ sarvāntaḥ satatasannihitam | naumi sadoditamitthaṃ nijadehagadevatācakram

essence: Body declared god's temple, self the eternal god: worship with I-am-He feeling after casting ignorance.
Breath-bodied Gaṇapati first-worshipped: saluted by all beings, bestowing wished boons.
Vaṭuka apāna-named, worshipped by adepts: remover of the humble folk's pain and doubt.
Sadguru's mind-strength makes the universe shine Śiva-pathed: attention itself the gift.
Sense-goddesses feast the heart-lotus: consciousness-made bliss-Bhairava at the core.
Bhairavī's ceaseless world-play of dawning and digesting: reflection-formed, ever praised.
Brāhmī intellect-formed offers resolve-flowers from the lord's petal: perception confirmed.
Śāmbhavī mother offers I-flowers from fire's petal: ego itself the oblation.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta with bhakti (wonder held in devotion)
rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya with rati (wonder with loving attachment)
rasa.justification: The body disclosed as temple seating gods in every faculty: wonder at the ordinary made divine, carried by the repeated I-praise. Desire-to-praise, not to know, drives each beholding.

sections.SUMMARY: Body named temple, self named eternal god: ignorance swept off, worship in I-am-He feeling. Breath-bodied Gaṇapati first, saluted by all, giving wished boons. Vaṭuka apāna-named, adepts at his feet, lifting humble pain and doubt. The true guru spotless, whose mind-strength shines the world Śiva-pathed. Sense-goddesses feasting the heart-lotus for consciousness-made bliss-Bhairava. Bhairavī reflection-formed, dawning and digesting the world unceasing. Brāhmī intellect-formed offering resolve-flowers from the lord's petal. Śāmbhavī mother offering I-flowers from fire's petal.
sections.FUNCTION: Sets body as temple, posts breath as gatekeepers, gives attention as the guru's gift, seats bliss at the core, and starts the flower-offerings.
sections.KEY TERMS: deho devālayaḥ (body-as-temple — the ground of the whole round); so'ham (I-am-He feeling as worship-mode); prāṇa/apāna (outgoing/ingoing breaths as gatekeepers); avadhāna (attention as the guru's gift); cinmaya (made of consciousness); vimarśa (reflection as her form); kusuma (flowers as sense-offerings); ahaṅkṛti (I-making as act, not thing).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Gatekeepers honored and the presiding pair enthroned, perception and ego lead the directional round.
sections.BOUNDARY: All giving here is praise; nothing is demanded.
sections.EXPLANATION: The body turns from dwelling to temple and the self from tenant to god, with one act of sweeping and one feeling of identity. Then the doors: prāṇa and apāna as Gaṇapati and Vaṭuka, worshipped first because breath holds the house together. The guru gives the only instrument that matters — attention — by which the world shines walkable toward Śiva. At the center sits bliss, consciousness-made, fed by the senses themselves; beside him reflection, digesting the world she dawns. The circle starts dealing its flowers: resolve from intellect in the east, I-ness from ego in the southeast fire.
sections.RELATED: Dyczkowski two-part blog (gatekeeper ascriptions, śuddha-vidyā note, heat/fire gloss for vimarśa); amritananda forum per-verse exposition; Lakshmanjoo lineage hymns page (The Goddess Within).

essence: Kaumārī mind-formed offers distinction-flowers from the south: thoughts themselves the gift.
Vaiṣṇavī hearing-formed offers sound-flowers from the southwest: listening itself the rite.
Vārāhī skin-formed delights with touch-flowers from the west: feeling itself pleasing.
Indrāṇī sight-bodied honors with choicer forms from the northwest: seeing itself worship.
Cāmuṇḍā tongue-called honors with six-taste foods from the north: tasting itself offered.
Mahālakṣmī nose-called worshipped with perfumes from the northeast: smelling itself the rite; circle complete.
Kṣetrapati self-named, 36-reality-infused, worshipped in six views: the experiencer guards the field.
The quivering experience-pith ever near: one's own god-circle hymned as first-person presence.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder circling home to rest)
rasa.justification: Six sense-offerings complete the round and the field-lord gathers them into one experiencer; the round rests the wonder it built. Praise that began in beholding ends in belonging.

sections.SUMMARY: Kaumārī mind-formed with distinction-flowers from the south: thoughts offered. Vaiṣṇavī hearing-formed with sound-flowers from the southwest: listening laid down. Vārāhī skin-formed delighting with touch-flowers from the west. Indrāṇī sight-bodied honoring with choicer forms from the northwest. Cāmuṇḍā tongue-called honoring with six-taste foods from the north. Mahālakṣmī nose-called worshipped with perfumes from the northeast: the circle stands complete. Kṣetrapati self-named, thirty-six-reality-infused, worshipable in six views, giver of siddhis. The quivering pith of experience ever near: my own body's god-circle hymned.
sections.FUNCTION: Completes the offerings sense by sense, gathers them into the field's one experiencer, and rests the round in first-person presence.
sections.KEY TERMS: kusuma-pattern (each sense offers its own flowers — resolve, distinction, sound, touch, forms, tastes, perfumes); manas/śruti/tvac/dṛk/jihvā/ghrāṇa (six sense-powers as goddesses); kṣetrapati (field-lord as first-person experiencer); ṣaṭtriṃśattattva (thirty-six as the full map); ṣaḍdarśana (six views as unanimous witness); viśeṣa (distinction — edition text, vikalpa variant recorded); śabda (sound — edition text, śabdarūpā variant recorded).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Six petals yet to give; the field-lord gathers the many offerers into one experiencer; beholding turns to belonging.
sections.BOUNDARY: Distinction-flowers and sound-flowers stand as offered; the thoughts-reading and the sound-formed reading wait aside. The count of tattvas and views is stated, never derived.
sections.EXPLANATION: Each remaining sense brings its own flowers: thoughts from mind in the south, sounds from hearing in the southwest, touch from skin in the west, forms from sight in the northwest, tastes from tongue in the north, perfumes from smell in the northeast. Nothing in the body is rejected; every sense becomes an offerer. Then the field itself gets its lord: worshipable wherever looked for, infused with all thirty-six realities, self-named, giving powers. Quivering experience, within all, ever near — one's own circle, hymned as oneself.
sections.RELATED: Dyczkowski per-verse exposition (petal-direction mapping, Kṣetrapati as first-person experiencer); print variants v9 (vikalpa) and v10 (śabdarūpā) flagged in argmaps; Sharada ms (Jammu No 67) different opening — transmission noted, not collated.
